analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive day. RSI is consolidating in the neutral zone at 63.7, while the MACD histogram is improving to 381.8328, continuing the bullish trend. A Higher Low pattern is confirmed with the current price rising relative to the 5-day low, indicating a recovery signal. Trading volume is subdued at 0.80 times the 5-day average, necessitating confirmation of further upward momentum.
